If you want Matcha, this is the only place in Vietnam that serves Real Matcha.
Dec 2025 • Couples
If you have ever wondered why every single matcha product in vietnam taste flowery and not even close to matcha, its purely because it is not matcha.

Japanit is a wonderful chain specialised in high quality matcha, hojicha and black sesame. 
The quality of the ceremonial grade matcha is remarkable.

Together we have tried the anmitsu, ceremonial matcha and iced hojicha latte. What made the experience even better was the fact that we got a complemantary iced matcha to be able to compare the flavours.

The matcha anmistu was sublime. Especially the ice cream that you usually wont find with the original. Other than that you find the typical fruit (here peach), jelly and shiratama mochi.

The ceremonial matcha comes iced in a round glass dish with a shot of milk in it. Not enough to take away the bitter and sweet experience but to create a smooth and creamy liquid.

The iced hojicha latte was intense. Roasted and flavourfull in a way that i have not had it ever before. You have to accept that it comes very sweet as usual for vietnam so you cant be mad about that.

Delicious stuff!! Matcha fans, come here!
Jun 2017 • Solo
I really love matcha crepe cakes and was looking for a place in Saigon that made them.
Did some research and ended up coming here. 
I had a Matcha 'Cappuccino' which was amazing, never had that before, it's a different kind of matcha latte, really, a bit more sweet and creamy. And, of course, I had my crepe cake which was pretty good, not the best I've had, but certainly good and always a pleasure to have one.
The staff are nice and friendly and the main guy spoke good English.
Yes it is a bit overpriced for Vietnam, but this is a gourmet niche type of cafe, so I'm not surprised. I paid about 5 USD for the hot drink and cake, I think that's alright.
If you're a matcha fan and crepe cake fan, definitely come here! They have all sorts of matcha cakes, ice creams, drinks, it's great.
